title: Add Media File
intro: WordPress’s Media → Add New is a drag-and-drop uploader that puts files into the Media Library independent of any post. Backdrop stores files as entities too, with an upload form of its own.
wordpress: A full-page drop zone; uploaded files land in the Media Library and can be attached to posts later.
backdrop: Files are managed by the File module: upload one at a time at file/add, or let an image or file field on a content type upload while you write. All files are listed under Manage files.
